title: Crypto payments for merchants
summary: Let shops accept crypto with lower fees than cards.
whyTempting: Card fees are a real pain for merchants.
whyItFails: Consumers don't pay in crypto. Holders don't want to spend appreciating assets. Volatility and tax complexity. Every payment becomes a tax event in many jurisdictions. Card networks fight back. Rewards make cards attractive to consumers.
whatWouldChange: Stablecoins with clear regulation and real consumer incentives.

attempts.notes: Signed up thousands of merchants; Steam dropped bitcoin via BitPay in 2017 over fees and volatility.

attempts.outcome: Shut down; assets sold to Silvergate Bank

reasons.detail: Consumers don't pay in crypto: Holders don't want to spend appreciating assets.
Volatility and tax complexity: Every payment becomes a tax event in many jurisdictions.
Card networks fight back: Rewards make cards attractive to consumers.
